title: NLL Hub V2  Auto Farm and Auto Progress
features:
NLL Hub v2.0.5 — premium keyed hub with WindUI menu (Farm · Combat · Dungeon · Character · Settings · Info).

FARM: Orbit auto farm (radius, speed, height), auto combat while farming, mob ESP (boss/add colors).

COMBAT: Auto combat (Swing / M1 / spells), boss fights kill adds first, no-cooldown UI bypass.

DUNGEON: Auto start (CreateLobby → StartLobby → StartDungeon), auto retry on clear, auto progress (level-based map + difficulty), auto spawn companion, Play Solo / Create Lobby / Retry / Return Lobby buttons, all maps supported incl. Ragnarök's Descent.

CHARACTER: Auto stat build (% physical/spell/health), auto claim milestones (5–260), walk/jump sliders, auto equip best gear.

SETTINGS: Config profiles (save/load/rename), custom Discord webhook (level, coins, gems, dungeon events), auto leave when staff joins, anti-AFK, fast respawn, low performance mode, keybinds, unload button.

KEY: Luarmor HWID-locked keys, mobile + desktop key UI, saved key, expiry auto-unload. Free key via ads link above. Join Discord for support and updates.

changelog.message: Initial release — NLL Hub v2.0.5 with orbit farm, auto dungeon, auto progress, Luarmor key gate, WindUI menu, profiles & webhooks.
